::: {#exr-negate-forall}
#### Not every test passes

Let $T$ be the set of tests in a test suite,
and let $P(t)$ be "test $t$ passes".
The report "every test passes" is $\forall t \in T, P(t)$.

Write the negation of this report in English and in symbols,
without putting $\neg$ in front of a quantifier.

:::
